description: Add the single-source permission catalogue (PERMISSIONS) and the template-role→permission map (ROLE_PERMISSIONS) to packages/shared, consumed by the API engine, the seed, the login resolver, and the catalogue-sync meta-test. Foundation feature with no dependencies on the other FEATs; everything else transcribes or imports these. Keys are derived from the REAL routes per design §4 and MUST match exactly (the FEAT-002 migration hand-transcribes them and a meta-test asserts set-equality).
steps: Create c:/campusgate/packages/shared/src/permissions.ts following the shape in design §4: `export interface PermissionDef { key: string; module: string; description: string }`; `export const PERMISSIONS = [...] as const satisfies readonly PermissionDef[]` containing EVERY key in design §4 — the campus_movement.* set (pass.request, pass.cancel, pass.view_own, pass.view_department, pass.approve, pass.reject, pass.revoke, pass.override, gate.verify, gate.mark_exit, gate.mark_return, gate.lookup, shift.manage_own, emergency.view, emergency.declare, emergency.resolve, analytics.view, audit.view), the admin.* set (users.view/create/approve/deactivate/reactivate, students.import/export, departments.manage, gates.manage, shifts.manage, reasons.manage, allowance_policy.manage, institution_config.manage, academic_calendar.manage), and the platform.* set (institutions.manage, analytics.view, onboarding, entitlements.manage, subscriptions.manage, support.grant, security.respond) each with its module and a short description; `export type PermissionKey = (typeof PERMISSIONS)[number]['key']`; `export const PERMISSION_KEYS = PERMISSIONS.map(p => p.key)`.

In the same file add `export const ROLE_PERMISSIONS: Record<string, readonly PermissionKey[]>` with the design §5 map exactly: STUDENT → [campus_movement.pass.request, .pass.cancel, .pass.view_own, .emergency.view]; GUARD → [campus_movement.gate.verify, .gate.mark_exit, .gate.mark_return, .gate.lookup, .shift.manage_own, .emergency.view]; HOD → [campus_movement.pass.view_department, .pass.approve, .pass.reject, .pass.revoke, .pass.override, .emergency.view]; ADMIN → all admin.* keys PLUS campus_movement.pass.revoke, .pass.override, .emergency.declare, .emergency.resolve, .emergency.view, .analytics.view, .audit.view; SUPER_ADMIN → all platform.* keys (NO campus_movement.* or admin.*).
Re-export the new module from c:/campusgate/packages/shared/src/index.ts (`export * from './permissions.js';`) alongside the existing constants/validation exports.
Build the shared package so the dist output exists for downstream runtime consumers.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/shared` compiles clean (no TS errors) and emits packages/shared/dist/index.js
PERMISSIONS contains every design §4 key with no typo and no extra/missing key; ROLE_PERMISSIONS matches design §5 exactly for all five role keys
ROLE_PERMISSIONS values are all members of PERMISSION_KEYS (no dangling permission key)
`node -e "const s=require('./packages/shared/dist/index.js'); console.log(s.PERMISSIONS.length, Object.keys(s.ROLE_PERMISSIONS).length)"` prints a non-zero permission count and 5 role keys
verification: From repo root: `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/shared` succeeds

From repo root: `node -e "const s=require('./packages/shared/dist/index.js'); const keys=new Set(s.PERMISSION_KEYS); for (const r of Object.keys(s.ROLE_PERMISSIONS)) for (const k of s.ROLE_PERMISSIONS[r]) if(!keys.has(k)) throw new Error('dangling '+k); console.log('ok', s.PERMISSIONS.length)"` prints ok and exits 0
findings:
DONE. Created packages/shared/src/permissions.ts and re-exported from index.ts (`export * from './permissions.js';`). Shared package built clean (tsc exit 0), dist/index.js emitted. Verification: node check prints `ok 39` and `39 5` (39 permissions, 5 role keys, no dangling key).

PERMISSION COUNT = 39, split 18 campus_movement + 14 admin + 7 platform.

EXACT PERMISSION_KEYS (order as in PERMISSIONS, authoritative for the FEAT-002 migration hand-transcription + meta-test set-equality):
campus_movement.pass.request, campus_movement.pass.cancel, campus_movement.pass.view_own, campus_movement.pass.view_department, campus_movement.pass.approve, campus_movement.pass.reject, campus_movement.pass.revoke, campus_movement.pass.override, campus_movement.gate.verify, campus_movement.gate.mark_exit, campus_movement.gate.mark_return, campus_movement.gate.lookup, campus_movement.shift.manage_own, campus_movement.emergency.view, campus_movement.emergency.declare, campus_movement.emergency.resolve, campus_movement.analytics.view, campus_movement.audit.view, admin.users.view, admin.users.create, admin.users.approve, admin.users.deactivate, admin.users.reactivate, admin.students.import, admin.students.export, admin.departments.manage, admin.gates.manage, admin.shifts.manage, admin.reasons.manage, admin.allowance_policy.manage, admin.institution_config.manage, admin.academic_calendar.manage, platform.institutions.manage, platform.analytics.view, platform.onboarding, platform.entitlements.manage, platform.subscriptions.manage, platform.support.grant, platform.security.respond.

ROLE_PERMISSIONS role keys = exactly STUDENT, GUARD, HOD, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN (5). Counts: STUDENT=4, GUARD=6, HOD=6, ADMIN=21 (all 14 admin.* + 7 campus_movement: pass.revoke, pass.override, emergency.declare, emergency.resolve, emergency.view, analytics.view, audit.view), SUPER_ADMIN=7 (all platform.*, NO campus_movement.* or admin.*). Total (roleKey,permKey) pairs = 44 — FEAT-002 migration role_permissions INSERT must transcribe exactly these 44 pairs; the meta-test asserts set-equality against ROLE_PERMISSIONS.

Naming decisions: module values are literally 'campus_movement', 'admin', 'platform'. PermissionDef shape = { key; module; description } with `PERMISSIONS ... as const satisfies readonly PermissionDef[]`, `PermissionKey = (typeof PERMISSIONS)[number]['key']`, `PERMISSION_KEYS = PERMISSIONS.map(p => p.key)`, `ROLE_PERMISSIONS: Record<string, readonly PermissionKey[]>`. No extra/missing keys vs design §4/§5.
